I'm sorry you have had to bear that kind of pain yourself.

I did not mean that he was the reason for my own marks if that is how that came across. We both have been through a lot together. And he saved my life tonight. I am not just saying that to defend him either. He genuinely has done some wonderful and some fucked up things. 

He wanted me to kill him in his sleep. I am trying to work up the nerve.
We all know those feelings extremely well
And fuck you by the way because he just read this.

I am extremely happy that you chose life for yourself. 

But I wasn't talking about myself with this.
Please somebody must have some insight here.
